capabilities: View rendered Mermaid diagrams with inline controls and a full-screen pan/zoom viewer
Visually edit flowchart nodes, connectors, and free lines on a canvas
Preserve unsupported Mermaid syntax and store layout metadata inside the fenced block
Export diagrams as PNG/JPG individually or batch-export all diagrams in a note
Review source diffs before applying canvas edits back to the code block
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Install is manual (download main.js, manifest.json, styles.css from GitHub releases). Visual editing is deliberately limited to flowcharts plus basic state/sequence support; other syntax is preserved as source only.
intentEvidence: Keep Mermaid source editable while using inline controls, a full-screen viewer, and a visual canvas for supported diagram structures.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid blocks read-only, so changing a diagram means hand-editing code and exporting images requires external tools.

relations.evidence: These projects work together, but you do not need to install everything.
Pick the tool for the part of the workflow you want to improve.

summary: Mermaid diagram toolkit that adds zoomable inspection, visual flowchart editing, and PNG/JPG export while preserving the original fenced-block source.
